text:
Silver Price in 2016
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2016, the LBMA silver price rose 15.3% between 2016-01-29 ($14.08) and 2016-12-30 ($16.24). The highest sampled price was $20.04 in July and the lowest was $14.08 in January. The mean of these observations was $17.11. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
